subject: planner: fix CTE hang or wrong result when multiple Apply is used (#55553)
summary: Updates planner utility `ExtractOuterApplyCorrelatedCols` to compute correlated columns bottom-up by collecting all inner `Apply` outer-side schemas from the subtree and filtering against them. This avoids incorrectly treating correlated columns from internal Apply operators (especially under PhysicalCTE-like nodes whose `ExtractCorrelatedCols` aggregates from nested plans) as “outer” correlations, preventing correlated-CTE caching/reset misbehavior that can lead to hangs or wrong results in multi-Apply CTE plans.
